title: A goal research story whose notes say no outside facts holds no kb root touches, so its claim meets no other session's claimed article
goal: new sprint, or check at planning, leaves a goal research story whose notes say 'No outside facts' with no kb/<root>/** touch (or warns of one), so held --overlaps does not report it against another session's claimed articles and ledgers

run:
import sys, tempfile, os, io, contextlib, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_base, bl_check
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q', d], check=True)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, 'kb', 'public'))
bl = bl_base.Backlog(d)
bl.items['SP-aaaaaaaa'] = dict(id='SP-aaaaaaaa', kind='sprint', title='s', status='planned', goal='g')
bl.items['ST-bbbbbbbb'] = dict(id='ST-bbbbbbbb', kind='story', title='Research sprint goal: s', status='draft', sprint='SP-aaaaaaaa', goal_research=True, priority='P1', goal='research', notes='No outside facts: the goal needs none.', touches=['kb/public/**'], checks=[dict(run=['python3', '-c', 'pass'])])
out = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out):
    bl_check.cmd_check(bl, None)
hit = [l for l in out.getvalue().splitlines() if 'ST-bbbbbbbb' in l and 'outside facts' in l.lower()]
sys.exit(0 if hit else 1)
